newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Sacramento County, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Deputy County Executive of the County of Sacramento (the
California, intends to offer for public sale on

at 8:00 a.m. California time, at his office, 700 H Street, Room 7650, Sacramento, California 95814-1280, $205,000,000 aggregate principal amount of temporary notes of the County designated County of Sacramento 1997 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes''.
